system.description: Grimoire (400j). Requires: 6 hours, 15 Spell Uses. Lasts: Indefinitely. The target obeys a single command, no matter its intelligence or how dangerous or self-destructive. Afterwards, if it can, it regains its own will. Cast from a book: not usable in combat; Skimpy armour or none; if the caster joins combat the spell is interrupted.
